def process(reportsByType2024) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType2024.copy()

    # First row contains the real header values
    header = df.iloc[0].tolist()
    df = df.iloc[1:].copy()
    df.columns = [str(x).strip() for x in header]

    # Keep numeric years only (drops trailing source rows)
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()].copy()
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)

    # Parse comma-separated integers
    for c in ['Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']:
        df[c] = (
            df[c]
            .astype(str)
            .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
            .str.strip()
        )
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')

    row2024 = df[df['Year'] == 2024].iloc[0]
    fraud = float(row2024['Fraud'])
    total = float(row2024[['Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']].sum())
    pct = int(round(100 * fraud / total))

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'Year': 2024,
        'Fraud': fraud,
        'TotalReports': total,
        'FraudPercentRoundedInt': pct
    }])
